# Building accessible forms

A form that only works by sight and by mouse shuts out the readers who most need it to work.

## Labels

Every field needs a label tied to it. A placeholder is not a label: it disappears as soon as someone types.

## Errors

Say what went wrong next to the field, in words, and move focus to the first problem. Color alone tells a colorblind reader nothing.
